mistakes.title: Differential pair length mismatch
mistakes.explanation: USB2_D+ is 2.4mm, USB2_D- is 5.5mm (3.2mm difference). Usb 2.0 High-Speed requires < 2.0mm length difference to maintain signal timing. Mismatched lengths cause timing skew that degrades signal quality.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add serpentine to USB2_D+ to match USB2_D- length, or shorten the USB2_D- routing path. Target: 5.5mm for both traces.

mistakes.title: Power trace too narrow
mistakes.explanation: Power trace on USB2_D+ is only 0.25mm wide. Narrow power traces cause voltage drop and can overheat under load. For 1A at 1oz copper, traces should be at least 0.5mm wide.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Increase trace width on USB2_D+ to at least 0.3mm, or use a copper pour for power distribution. Consider the expected current draw.

mistakes.title: Power trace too narrow
mistakes.explanation: Power trace on USB3_TX1+ is only 0.28mm wide. Narrow power traces cause voltage drop and can overheat under load. For 1A at 1oz copper, traces should be at least 0.5mm wide.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Increase trace width on USB3_TX1+ to at least 0.3mm, or use a copper pour for power distribution. Consider the expected current draw.
